_readme: Layering rules for tools/check_architecture.py. Delete this file to switch the check off.
modules: a .gd file belongs to the first module whose globs match it, so order matters.
globs       Project-relative paths. * stays inside one folder, ** crosses folders.
A glob that matches nothing fails; write {"glob": "...", "optional": true}
may_depend  Modules this one may name (class_name, autoload, preload, load, extends).
"*" allows any. A module may always name itself.
pure        true: no Node-derived class, no signal, no autoload. Logic that runs
ignore: globs for scripts the check leaves alone. A script in no module and not
ignored fails, so a new folder cannot dodge the rules.
cycles: true (the default) fails scripts that preload or extend each other in a
ring; false turns that rule off.
To add a layer: add a module here, then name it in the may_depend of each module
that is allowed to use it. Example, a UI layer over the game:
placed before "game" if scripts/ui sits inside a folder that game's globs also match.

core._note: Rules and data: RefCounted and Resource scripts only.

game._note: Nodes and scenes' scripts, including any script beside project.godot.
